geometry.note: `verified` rests on `representation: surveyed` from a rank-10 arXiv technical paper (A15/A25), independent of any OSM check.
geometry.quote: at geographic coordinates Lat. 36°21′08.928″ ... N, Long. 137°18′49.688″ ... E, and an altitude of 508 m above sea level.

method: Coordinate taken directly from the Hyper-Kamiokande Letter of Intent (arXiv:1109.3262), Section II.1, which states the site's own geographic coordinates and altitude. accuracy_m is set wider than a typical survey point (150 m rather than the ~20 m a minute/second-precision coordinate would normally warrant) because the LOI's figure was published in 2011 as the 'proposed location' before cavern excavation began (2022, per src:hk-frontiers-2024-status); no later source fetched this session restates numeric coordinates to confirm the final excavated position did not shift. The value is corroborated: it sits 346 m from the existing site record's own independently-derived point (offset-from-Super-K method), and 8.15 km from Super-Kamiokande's own surveyed point on a bearing of 177.8 deg (i.e. very nearly due south), matching the qualitative 'approximately 8 km south' stated in multiple Hyper-K status papers.
name: Hyper-Kamiokande cavern (surveyed point, Tochibora)

summary.plain: The surveyed position of the Hyper-Kamiokande cavern under Mt. Nijuugoyama in the Tochibora mine, about 8 km south of Super-Kamiokande, from the experiment's own 2011 Letter of Intent.
